	[HarmonyPatch(typeof(MusicInfo), "GetLevelDesignerStringByIndex")]
	internal class LevelDesignerPatch
	{
		private static bool Prefix(MusicInfo __instance, ref string __result, int index)
		{
			if (1 == 0)
			{
			}
			Object val = default(Object);
			Object val2 = default(Object);
			Object val3 = default(Object);
			Object val4 = default(Object);
			Object val5 = default(Object);
			string text = index switch
			{
				1 => ((BaseDataObject)__instance).m_MaskValue.TryGetValue("levelDesigner1", ref val) ? val.ToString() : __instance.levelDesigner1, 
				2 => ((BaseDataObject)__instance).m_MaskValue.TryGetValue("levelDesigner2", ref val2) ? val2.ToString() : __instance.levelDesigner2, 
				3 => ((BaseDataObject)__instance).m_MaskValue.TryGetValue("levelDesigner3", ref val3) ? val3.ToString() : __instance.levelDesigner3, 
				4 => ((BaseDataObject)__instance).m_MaskValue.TryGetValue("levelDesigner4", ref val4) ? val4.ToString() : __instance.levelDesigner4, 
				5 => ((BaseDataObject)__instance).m_MaskValue.TryGetValue("levelDesigner5", ref val5) ? val5.ToString() : __instance.levelDesigner5, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("index", index, "The difficulty is not a valid index."), 
			};
			if (1 == 0)
			{
			}
			__result = text;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(__result) || __result == "?")
			{
				Object val6 = default(Object);
				__result = (((BaseDataObject)__instance).m_MaskValue.TryGetValue("levelDesigner", ref val6) ? val6.ToString() : __instance.levelDesigner);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(__result))
			{
				return false;
			}
			__result = "?????";
			return false;
		}
	}

	[HarmonyPatch(typeof(PnlRank), "UIRefresh")]
	internal class PnlRankPatch
	{
		private static bool FirstRun = true;

		private static bool Prefix(string uid, PnlRank __instance)
		{
			Text component = __instance.noNet.GetComponent<Text>();
			if (FirstRun)
			{
				OriginalNoNetText = component.text;
				FirstRun = false;
			}
			if (!uid.StartsWith($"{999}-") || HQPresent)
			{
				component.text = OriginalNoNetText;
				return true;
			}
			component.text = "Headquarters mod is not loaded! ~(*\u00b4Д\uff40)";
			__instance.noNet.SetActive(true);
			return false;
		}

		private static Exception Finalizer(Exception __exception, PnlRank __instance)
		{
			if (__exception != null)
			{
				Logger.Error("[PnlRank.UIRefresh] EXCEPTION THROWN: " + __exception.Message + "\n" + __exception.StackTrace);
				if ((Object)(object)__instance != (Object)null && (Object)(object)__instance.noNet != (Object)null)
				{
					Text component = __instance.noNet.GetComponent<Text>();
					if ((Object)(object)component != (Object)null)
					{
						component.text = "CRASH: " + __exception.Message + "\nCheck MelonLoader console for details.";
					}
					__instance.noNet.SetActive(true);
					if ((Object)(object)__instance.server != (Object)null)
					{
						__instance.server.SetActive(false);
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	[HarmonyPatch(typeof(GameAccountSystem), "GetRanks")]
	internal static class SafeGetRanksPatch
	{
		[HarmonyPriority(800)]
		private static bool Prefix(string musicUid, ref int difficulty)
		{
			if (!musicUid.StartsWith($"{999}-"))
			{
				return true;
			}
			try
			{
				Album byUid = AlbumManager.GetByUid(musicUid);
				if (byUid == null)
				{
					Logger.Warning("GetRanks: album 不存在 (uid=" + musicUid + ")，跳过");
					return false;
				}
				if (byUid.Sheets.ContainsKey(difficulty))
				{
					return true;
				}
				int selectedDiffTglIndex = GlobalDataBase.s_DbMusicTag.selectedDiffTglIndex;
				Logger.Warning($"GetRanks: difficulty {difficulty} → {selectedDiffTglIndex} (uid={musicUid})");
				difficulty = selectedDiffTglIndex;
				if (!byUid.Sheets.ContainsKey(difficulty))
				{
					Logger.Warning($"GetRanks: 修正后仍无效 diff={difficulty}，跳过");
					return false;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				Logger.Error("GetRanks 验证异常: " + ex.Message);
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	[HarmonyPatch(typeof(DataHelper), "CheckMusicUnlockMaster", new Type[]
	{
		typeof(MusicInfo),
		typeof(bool)
	})]
	internal class CheckUnlockMasterPatch
	{
		private static bool Prefix(MusicInfo musicInfo, ref bool __result)
		{
			SaveManager.SaveData.Ability = Math.Max(SaveManager.SaveData.Ability, GlobalDataBase.dbUi.ability);
			float num = (GameAccountSystem.instance.IsLoggedIn() ? SaveManager.SaveData.Ability : 0f);
			string text = ((musicInfo != null) ? musicInfo.uid : null);
			if (text == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (GlobalDataBase.dbUi.ability == 0f && num != 0f)
			{
				Logger.Msg("Fixing bugged vanilla state for master lock");
				int result;
				bool flag = !musicInfo.difficulty3.TryParseAsInt(out result) || num >= (float)result;
				int num2;
				if (!flag && !DataHelper.unlockMasters.Contains(text) && !SaveManager.SaveData.UnlockedMasters.Contains(AlbumManager.GetAlbumNameFromUid(text)))
				{
					Album byUid = AlbumManager.GetByUid(musicInfo.uid);
					num2 = ((byUid != null && !byUid.IsPackaged) ? 1 : 0);
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = 1;
				}
				__result = (byte)num2 != 0;
				return false;
			}
			if (!text.StartsWith($"{999}-"))
			{
				return true;
			}
			int result2;
			bool flag2 = !musicInfo.difficulty3.TryParseAsInt(out result2) || num >= (float)result2;
			__result = flag2 || SaveManager.SaveData.UnlockedMasters.Contains(AlbumManager.GetAlbumNameFromUid(text)) || !AlbumManager.GetByUid(musicInfo.uid).IsPackaged;
			return false;
		}
	}

		}

	[HarmonyPatch(typeof(DBMusicTag), "AddHistory")]
	internal class AddHistoryPatch
	{
		private static bool Prefix(string musicUid)
		{
			if (!musicUid.StartsWith($"{999}-"))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!ModSettings.SavingEnabled)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string albumNameFromUid = AlbumManager.GetAlbumNameFromUid(musicUid);
			SaveManager.SaveData.History.Remove(albumNameFromUid);
			SaveManager.SaveData.History.Add(albumNameFromUid);
			if (SaveManager.SaveData.History.Count > 10)
			{
				SaveManager.SaveData.History.RemoveAt(0);
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	[HarmonyPatch(typeof(GameAccountSystem), "UploadScore")]
	internal class UploadScorePatch
	{
		private static void Postfix(SceneUploadResultData resData)
		{
			if (resData.musicUid.StartsWith($"{999}-"))
			{
				SaveManager.SaveScore(resData.musicUid, resData.musicDifficulty, resData.score, resData.accuracy, resData.combo, resData.evaluate, resData.miss);
			}
		}
	}

	[HarmonyPatch(typeof(PnlVictory), "SetScore")]
	internal class SetScorePatch
	{
		private static void Postfix(PnlVictory __instance)
		{
			if (((Object)__instance.m_CurControls.mainPnl.transform.parent).name == "Djmax")
			{
				Transform val = __instance.m_CurControls.mainPnl.transform.Find("PnlVictory_3D").Find("SongTittle").Find("ImgSongTittleMask");
				GameObject gameObject = ((Component)val.Find("TxtSongTittle")).gameObject;
				if (!gameObject.active)
				{
					((Component)val.Find("MaskPos")).gameObject.SetActive(true);
				}
			}
			if (!ModSettings.SavingEnabled || !GlobalDataBase.dbBattleStage.musicUid.StartsWith($"{999}-"))
			{
				return;
			}
			string albumNameFromUid = AlbumManager.GetAlbumNameFromUid(GlobalDataBase.dbBattleStage.musicUid);
			if (SaveManager.SaveData.Highest.TryGetValue(albumNameFromUid, out var value))
			{
				int mapDifficulty = GlobalDataBase.s_DbBattleStage.m_MapDifficulty;
				((Behaviour)__instance.m_CurControls.highScoreTitle).enabled = SaveManager.PreviousScore != "-";
				((Behaviour)__instance.m_CurControls.highScoreTxt).enabled = SaveManager.PreviousScore != "-";
				int score = Singleton<TaskStageTarget>.instance.GetScore();
				if (!value.ContainsKey(mapDifficulty))
				{
					__instance.m_CurControls.newBest.SetActive(true);
				}
				if (SaveManager.PreviousScore != "-")
				{
					__instance.m_CurControls.newBest.SetActive(score > int.Parse(SaveManager.PreviousScore));
				}
				__instance.m_CurControls.highScoreTxt.text = SaveManager.PreviousScore;
			}
		}
	}

	[HarmonyPatch(typeof(PnlPreparation), "OnBattleStart")]
	internal class OnBattleStartPatch
	{
		private static void Postfix()
		{
			if (ModSettings.SavingEnabled && !DataHelper.selectedMusicUidFromInfoList.StartsWith("album_"))
			{
				SaveManager.SaveData.SelectedAlbum = DataHelper.selectedMusicUidFromInfoList;
			}
		}
	}

	[HarmonyPatch(typeof(SteamSync), "SaveLocal")]
	internal class SaveLocalPatch
	{
		private static bool BackedUp { get; set; }

		private static void Prefix()
		{
			if (ModSettings.SavingEnabled && DataHelper.selectedMusicUidFromInfoList.StartsWith($"{999}-"))
			{
				SaveManager.SaveData.SelectedAlbum = AlbumManager.GetAlbumNameFromUid(DataHelper.selectedMusicUidFromInfoList) ?? "";
			}
			if (ModSettings.SavingEnabled)
			{
				SaveManager.SaveSaveFile();
			}
			CleanCustomData();
		}

		private static void Postfix()
		{
			if (ModSettings.SavingEnabled)
			{
				if (!BackedUp)
				{
					Backup.InitBackups();
				}
				BackedUp = true;
				InjectCustomData();
			}
		}
	}

	[HarmonyPatch(typeof(SteamSync), "LoadLocal")]
	internal class LoadLocalPatch
	{
		private static void Postfix()
		{
			CleanCustomData();
			if (ModSettings.SavingEnabled)
			{
				InjectCustomData();
			}
		}
	}

	[HarmonyPatch(typeof(GameAccountSystem), "RefreshDatas")]
	internal class RefreshDatasPatch
	{
		private static void Postfix()
		{
			Backup.InitBackups();
			SaveManager.SaveSaveFile();
			CleanCustomData();
			if (ModSettings.SavingEnabled)
			{
				InjectCustomData();
			}
		}
	}

	[HarmonyPatch(typeof(GameAccountSystem), "OnSaveSelectCallback")]
	internal class OnSaveSelectPatch
	{
		private static void Prefix(ref bool isLocal)
		{
			if (isLocal)
			{
				if (ModSettings.SavingEnabled)
				{
					SaveManager.SaveSaveFile();
				}
				CleanCustomData();
			}
		}

		private static void Postfix(ref bool isLocal)
		{
			if (ModSettings.SavingEnabled && isLocal)
			{
				InjectCustomData();
			}
		}
	}

	[UnmanagedFunctionPointer(CallingConvention.Cdecl)]
	private delegate IntPtr RecordBattleArgsDelegate(IntPtr instance, IntPtr args, IntPtr isSuccess, IntPtr nativeMethodInfo);

	internal static bool? _hqPresent = null;

	private static string OriginalNoNetText;

	internal static readonly Logger Logger = new Logger("SavePatch");

	internal static readonly string[] EvalToGrade = new string[7] { "D", "C", "B", "A", "S", "S", "S" };

	private static readonly NativeHook<RecordBattleArgsDelegate> Hook = new NativeHook<RecordBattleArgsDelegate>();

	internal static bool HQPresent
	{
		get
		{
			bool valueOrDefault = _hqPresent == true;
			bool result;
			if (!_hqPresent.HasValue)
			{
				valueOrDefault = MelonBase.FindMelon("Headquarters", "AshtonMemer") != null;
				_hqPresent = valueOrDefault;
				result = valueOrDefault;
			}
			else
			{
				result = valueOrDefault;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

	private static void SetPanelWithData(PnlRecord panel, ChartSave data, bool isFullCombo)
	{
		//IL_009e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		if (isFullCombo)
		{
			panel.imgIconFc.SetActive(true);
			((Graphic)panel.txtCombo).color = ((Il2CppArrayBase<Color>)(object)panel.gradeColor)[6];
		}
		int evaluate = data.Evaluate;
		panel.txtAccuracy.text = data.AccuracyStr;
		panel.txtClear.text = data.Clear.ToStringInvariant();
		panel.txtCombo.text = data.Combo.ToStringInvariant();
		panel.txtGrade.text = EvalToGrade[evaluate];
		((Graphic)panel.txtGrade).color = ((Il2CppArrayBase<Color>)(object)panel.gradeColor)[evaluate];
		panel.txtScore.text = data.Score.ToStringInvariant();
	}

	private static void ClearAndRefreshPanels(PnlPreparation panelPreparation, bool reload)
	{
		panelPreparation.pnlRecord.Clear();
		panelPreparation.pnlRecord.imgIconFc.SetActive(false);
		foreach (PnlRank item in (Il2CppArrayBase<PnlRank>)(object)panelPreparation.pnlRanks)
		{
			item.Refresh(reload);
		}
	}

	private static int GetDifficulty(string uid)
	{
		int selectedDiffTglIndex = GlobalDataBase.s_DbMusicTag.selectedDiffTglIndex;
		Dictionary<string, HideBmsInfo> hideBmsInfos = Singleton<SpecialSongManager>.instance.m_HideBmsInfos;
		if (hideBmsInfos == null || !hideBmsInfos.ContainsKey(uid))
		{
			return selectedDiffTglIndex;
		}
		Dictionary<string, bool> isInvokeHideDic = Singleton<SpecialSongManager>.instance.m_IsInvokeHideDic;
		HideBmsInfo val = default(HideBmsInfo);
		if (isInvokeHideDic == null || !isInvokeHideDic.ContainsKey(uid) || !hideBmsInfos.TryGetValue(uid, ref val) || val == null)
		{
			return selectedDiffTglIndex;
		}
		return (isInvokeHideDic[uid] && selectedDiffTglIndex == val.triggerDiff) ? val.m_HideDiff : selectedDiffTglIndex;
	}

	private static bool InjectPnlPreparation(PnlPreparation __instance, bool forceReload)
	{
		MusicInfo val = GlobalDataBase.s_DbMusicTag.CurMusicInfo();
		if (val.albumJsonIndex != 1000)
		{
			return true;
		}
		ClearAndRefreshPanels(__instance, forceReload);
		LongSongNameController designerLongNameController = __instance.designerLongNameController;
		if (designerLongNameController != null)
		{
			designerLongNameController.Refresh(false);
		}
		if (!ModSettings.SavingEnabled)
		{
			return false;
		}
		PnlRecord pnlRecord = __instance.pnlRecord;
		SaveExtensions.SaveData chartSaveDataFromUid = SaveManager.SaveData.GetChartSaveDataFromUid(val.uid);
		Dictionary<int, ChartSave> highest = chartSaveDataFromUid.Highest;
		if (highest == null || highest.Count == 0)
		{
			Logger.Msg("No save data found for " + val.uid + ", nothing to inject");
			return false;
		}
		int difficulty = GetDifficulty(val.uid);
		bool isFullCombo = chartSaveDataFromUid.FullCombo?.Contains(difficulty) ?? false;
		ChartSave valueOrDefault = chartSaveDataFromUid.Highest.GetValueOrDefault(difficulty);
		if (valueOrDefault == null)
		{
			Logger.Msg($"Save data was found for the chart, but not for difficulty {difficulty}");
			return false;
		}
		SetPanelWithData(pnlRecord, valueOrDefault, isFullCombo);
		Logger.Msg($"Injecting {val.uid} with difficulty {difficulty}");
		return false;
	}

	private static void CleanCustomData()
	{
		DataHelper.hides.RemoveAll(Predicate<string>.op_Implicit((Func<string, bool>)((string uid) => uid.StartsWith($"{999}-"))));
		DataHelper.history.RemoveAll(Predicate<string>.op_Implicit((Func<string, bool>)((string uid) => uid.StartsWith($"{999}-"))));
		DataHelper.collections.RemoveAll(Predicate<string>.op_Implicit((Func<string, bool>)((string uid) => uid.StartsWith($"{999}-"))));
		DataHelper.highest.RemoveAll(Predicate<IData>.op_Implicit((Func<IData, bool>)((IData data) => data.GetUid().StartsWith($"{999}-"))));
		List<string> list = new List<string>();
		Enumerator<string, IData> enumerator = DataHelper.dicLevelConfig.GetEnumerator();
		while (enumerator.MoveNext())
		{
			KeyValuePair<string, IData> current = enumerator.Current;
			if (current.key.StartsWith("999"))
			{
				list.Add(current.key);
			}
		}
		foreach (string item in list)
		{
			DataHelper.dicLevelConfig.Remove(item);
		}
		if (DataHelper.selectedAlbumUid == "music_package_999")
		{
			DataHelper.selectedAlbumUid = "music_package_0";
		}
		if (DataHelper.selectedAlbumTagIndex == 999)
		{
			DataHelper.selectedAlbumTagIndex = 0;
		}
		if (DataHelper.selectedMusicUidFromInfoList.StartsWith($"{999}-"))
		{
			if (ModSettings.SavingEnabled)
			{
				SaveManager.SaveData.SelectedAlbum = AlbumManager.GetAlbumNameFromUid(DataHelper.selectedMusicUidFromInfoList);
			}
			DataHelper.selectedMusicUidFromInfoList = "0-0";
		}
	}

	private static void InjectCustomData()
	{
		if (ModSettings.SavingEnabled)
		{
			DataHelper.hides.AddManagedRange(SaveManager.SaveData.Hides.GetAlbumUidsFromNames());
			DataHelper.history.AddManagedRange(SaveManager.SaveData.History.GetAlbumUidsFromNames());
			DataHelper.collections.AddManagedRange(SaveManager.SaveData.Collections.GetAlbumUidsFromNames());
			if (SaveManager.SaveData.SelectedAlbum.StartsWith("album_"))
			{
				DataHelper.selectedAlbumUid = "music_package_999";
				DataHelper.selectedAlbumTagIndex = 999;
				DataHelper.selectedMusicUidFromInfoList = (AlbumManager.LoadedAlbums.TryGetValue(SaveManager.SaveData.SelectedAlbum, out var value) ? value.Uid : "0-0");
			}
		}
	}

	[UnmanagedCallersOnly(CallConvs = new Type[] { typeof(CallConvCdecl) })]
	private static IntPtr RecordBattleArgsPatch(IntPtr instance, IntPtr args, IntPtr isSuccess, IntPtr nativeMethodInfo)
	{
		return (!GlobalDataBase.s_DbBattleStage.musicUid.StartsWith($"{999}-")) ? Hook.Trampoline(instance, args, isSuccess, nativeMethodInfo) : IntPtr.Zero;
	}

	internal unsafe static void AttachHook()
	{
		MethodInfo methodInfo = AccessTools.Method(typeof(AchievementManager), "RecordBattleArgs", new Type[2]
		{
			typeof(GlobalAchievementArgs).MakeByRefType(),
			typeof(bool)
		}, (Type[])null);
		if ((object)methodInfo == null)
		{
			Logger.Error("FATAL ERROR: SavePatch failed.");
			Thread.Sleep(1000);
			Environment.Exit(1);
		}
		IntPtr target = *(IntPtr*)(void*)(IntPtr)Il2CppInteropUtils.GetIl2CppMethodInfoPointerFieldForGeneratedMethod((MethodBase)methodInfo).GetValue(null);
		delegate* unmanaged[Cdecl]<IntPtr, IntPtr, IntPtr, IntPtr, IntPtr> delegate* = &RecordBattleArgsPatch;
		Hook.Detour = (IntPtr)delegate*;
		Hook.Target = target;
		Hook.Attach();
	}
